question.text: Under SEBI's PMS onboarding requirements, which document must a portfolio manager provide to a client in the standard SEBI-prescribed format at the time of onboarding?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook requires PMS clients to be provided a Most Important Terms and Conditions (MITC) document in the standard format prescribed by SEBI at the time of onboarding. The workbook references a SEBI circular (footnoted as dated May 2024) introducing this standard MITC requirement for portfolio managers. The Trap: Key Information Memorandum, Prospectus, and Red Herring Prospectus belong to mutual-fund and IPO frameworks, not to PMS onboarding. Note: Source - NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers Certification Examination workbook (Sep 2025), pp. 150-151.
